name: Saionji Kaoru
source:
Kaoru has a dysfunctional relationship with her parents. She studied eagerly from the idea that "If you study, your parents will be happy." However, it became the cause of not being able to communicate through methods other than studying.

Affiliation: Class president
After school: Goes to cram school.
Hobbies: 1000 mass calculation, reading reference books.

Her friends group members: [url=/c4270]Riri[/url], [url=/c4264]Non[/url], [url=/c4268]Ikuyo[/url], [url=/c4269]Asuka[/url].
